agents.name: Request a quote from matching suppliers
agents.description: Send a quote request to whobuildsit, which reviews it and passes it to suppliers who can make the part. Before calling, ASK THE USER for their work email and explicit consent to share the request and email with suppliers — never invent an email. Give a part_id or supplier_slug from earlier results when you have one. Suppliers reply to the user directly; nothing is sent automatically.

agents.name: Request a quote
agents.description: Send a request for prices, samples or terms to a manufacturer on the person's behalf. Requires the person's own name and email — ask them and pass exactly what they give you, never invent an address. The manufacturer receives the request; the person receives an email with a sign-in link where the reply and the supplier's contacts appear. No account is needed beforehand. Use it once they have chosen a supplier.
